target_customer: Retail crypto, stock and ETF investors who want rule-based automated trading without coding
problem: Retail investors cannot easily automate trading strategies that were limited to quants and hedge funds, and coding a bot is a barrier.
business_model: B2C SaaS subscription (free tier, paid plans from about $29.99 per month)

founders.name: Gabriele Musella
founders.background_notes: Employers and education as listed on the YC company page; the page also lists NHS and the British Government.

founders.name: Zdenek Hofler
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a full-stack builder with 20+ years of experience; no employers or education listed.

competitors.name: 3Commas
competitors.what: Crypto trading bots and smart trading terminal
competitors.traction_then: established bot platform; exact figures not found

competitors.name: Cryptohopper
competitors.what: Cloud crypto trading bot with strategy marketplace
competitors.traction_then: established bot platform; exact figures not found

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed reliable exchange API integrations and rule execution with security for user keys, standard engineering but operationally demanding.

defensibility.rationale: Many rival bots existed and rule builders were copyable; strategy templates and user setups gave mild lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Exchanges and bot rivals kept offering their own automation; no source shows Coinrule being copied or bought.

market_need_then: The 2020 to 2021 crypto boom drew many retail traders; by late 2021 Coinrule reported over 13,000 users and more than 100,000 strategies created in a month.

branding.domain_note: Uses coinrule.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, stresses zero code and simplicity, for example 'You call the shots, we automate the bots'.

branding.community_and_virality: Ran a Seedrs equity crowdfunding campaign (a community of small investors) and published a docufilm; no merch or fan evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name tells the rule-based idea, but no source shows press on the brand itself, mascot or community pull; search found nothing on its branding.

pivots.to: Multi-asset (stocks, ETFs, crypto) and AI-driven investing
pivots.why: Not stated in detail; the YC page lists an AI marketplace launch in Aug 2023 and a stocks and ETFs expansion reported Feb 2026.

outcome_analysis: Coinrule rode the 2021 retail crypto wave, reached over 13,000 users and closed a $2.2M seed at the time of YC. After the crypto downturn it trimmed the team and by late 2025 said it was near break-even, while pushing into stocks, ETFs and AI agents. It remains active and small, with no later priced round found.
notes: Search snippets mention an earlier Seedrs crowdfunding round with conflicting amounts (about 531k GBP, 570k EUR, over 410k GBP) and total funding figures from 2.9M to 3.55M USD; these were seen only in snippets or aggregators, so not recorded as a round. Finextra fetch was blocked (403); seed also reported by Finextra and Fintech Global in search results. Competitor sources are undated comparison pages from around 2018, so the as-of dating is weak. No outcome news found for layoffs besides a 2025 blog saying the team was trimmed slightly.
